title: Passive Voice: General Beliefs — Quiz 108
content:
## Passive Voice: General Beliefs

Learn two passive ways to report what people say or believe.

### Lesson focus

1. They say that honesty is the best policy.
2. It is said that honesty is the best policy.
3. Honesty is said to be the best policy.
4. They say that practice makes a man perfect.
5. People say that money brings happiness.
6. They say that work is worship.

### Understand the pattern

An impersonal reporting passive starts with it and a reporting verb such as is said or is believed. Another pattern starts with the subject of the reported claim and uses a passive reporting verb followed by an infinitive.

### Worked answers and explanation

People say that honesty is the best policy → It is said that honesty is the best policy; honesty is said to be the best policy. For 'People say that money brings happiness', a possible form is 'Money is said to bring happiness'. Reporting a belief does not establish that the belief is a proven fact.

### Try another

Rewrite: People believe that the library is very old.

### Suggested answer

It is believed that the library is very old; the library is believed to be very old. Both forms present a reported belief rather than identify a particular speaker.
